text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks D, B, and E at gains, but a realized gain feels good without proving the sale was the best choice; I should weigh future prospects, not my average cost.","My account rose overall but also fell in some periods, reminding me that short-term gains and losses are uncertain and past moves do not predict what comes next.","I made no trades for several periods, which can be a deliberate choice; I should avoid frequent reactions to daily noise and trade only for a clear reason."]}
